answer.reason: The verses only list Elam as a family head in census counts, lists of returning households and lists of signers or participants, and say nothing of anything the man himself did.
doubts: EZR 10:2 and EZR 10:26 concern his descendants confessing and putting away foreign wives, but that is the deed of the sons of Elam, not of Elam himself.
NEH 12:42 names an Elam among singers or priests at the wall dedication, probably a different man of the same name, so it is left out.
